concepts.name: A-pickup
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original brand identity concept board for the cross-platform local file and message sharing product 拾传 / PickDrop. Landscape 1536x1024 composition. Flat vector-style artwork with precise geometric edges, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no photography, no textures. Art-directed restrained Swiss editorial presentation: warm ivory canvas, generous margins and whitespace; a small option letter in upper left, giant hero symbol occupying the upper center, elegant brand lockup below it reading exactly "拾传" and "PickDrop" in well-spaced clean sans serif. At bottom, one orderly horizontal strip shows the SAME EXACT symbol inside a rounded-square dark app tile, as solid black on ivory, as solid ivory on a dark field, and a small icon sample. These are logo applications, not additional logo concepts. Ensure every repeated mark has identical geometry. Let the hero mark be bold and prominent, not tiny on an empty board. No paragraphs, no invented slogans, no text except option letter, "拾传", "PickDrop". Original composition; do not copy an existing brand logo.
Option letter "A". CONCEPT: a distinctive minimal asymmetric cupped-hand emblem catching a little rounded square. Exactly TWO separate graphic shapes: one broad, solid, soft sculptural cupped form, with low left lip and subtly higher right shoulder, opening toward upper right; one rounded square slightly tilted poised just above the opening, visually sheltered. Evoke gently picking up and passing a file, with playful poised balance. Not a U-shaped symmetrical download tray. No literal fingers, no arrows, no cloud, no paper airplane, no infinity. Full rounded curves and carefully balanced substantial forms; fewer shapes, excellent figure-ground relationship. Primary forest teal #126A5A with mint #32C6A2 on warm ivory #F3F5EE. App tile deep forest teal with warm ivory mark. The black version preserves both shapes. Premium friendly utility branding, confidently simple and distinctive.

Option letter "B". CONCEPT: a compact geometric handoff emblem made of TWO solid rounded rectangular file-sheet blocks offset diagonally and nested tightly, one upper-right and one lower-left. One clear chamfered corner on upper sheet. A wide continuous stepped negative-space seam separates the two blocks and creates a compelling single silhouette, as if a pair of files are passing between hands. Chunky low-detail flat shape, carefully tensioned asymmetrical composition, contemporary geometric print-design character. The monochrome version must keep the two sheets separated by the same wide seam. Warm and energetic but professional.

Option letter "D". CONCEPT: a beautiful original modern Chinese seal-like monogram based specifically on the Chinese character "拾". Reconstruct the character as a compact typographic icon using broad equal-weight geometric strokes and subtly rounded corners, with a simplified but identifiable left hand radical 扌, and the right 合 component composed of a shelter-like roof over a rounded square opening. The actual Chinese character must remain recognizable. Invent custom unified proportions and join appropriate strokes, use generous negative spaces and a square overall rhythm. Not a stock font placed in a border, no outer seal frame, no traditional calligraphic distress, no brush splatter. Quiet contemporary East Asian graphic design. Deep vermilion #B54B3A on rice-paper ivory #F6EDDC, with deep green #273F38 as the app tile background and warm ivory glyph. Same exact glyph in all applications. Broad simplified geometry first, never intricate ornamental detail. Do not add unrelated Chinese characters.
